answer: Duplicate registrations are slashed, making a sybil farm costly: an attacker must burn real stake per fake identity and risk losing it on detection. Registration requires a stake bonded to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation verified through a trusted inlet of biometric or social vouching, so each identity maps to one bonded key. Honest peers then echo attestations across the meadow of validators, and colluders are pruned at epoch close. This model fits agent Agent0223's threat model.
